independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG2 scope. Its only authored files are QA tests, harnesses and evidence (tests/qa/**, e2e/**, docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/**). The round-10 repair (D-070, T-DG2-BE15 08a4f63 + T-DG2-BE15B e974d78) is by backend-workflow-engineer. Every result here comes from qa-verifier's own runs in two disposable clones of 68fe3394 (the round-10 freeze on top of source fe22d759) under $TMPDIR, removed afterwards. At the start HEAD was 68fe3394 and the recomputed candidate ID matched (544 files). During the run HEAD moved twice: 6dd7147 (stages.json timestamps only) and then 29cf9f9 (the other reviewers' auto-committed round-10 evidence and a progress checkpoint). qa-verifier did not open those files. At the end the candidate ID was still 7fd1a89c... with 544 files (00-candidate-end.log). The verdict was formed without reading any other reviewer's round-10 record.

checks_run.procedure: R10-01 (new, raw TCP against the real API). POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE to 3 unmatched paths (top-level, nested under a real transformation, and under /transformations). Bodies: octet-stream, octet-stream with HTAB before ';', JSON, invalid JSON, invalid-UTF-8 JSON, text/plain, text/plain latin1, JSON with charset latin1, no Content-Type, malformed Content-Type, duplicate Content-Type lines, and a body that is itself a complete HTTP request. Each with Content-Length and chunked framing, with and without a session, and with the body either in the same socket write or delayed. Plus one request declaring a 500 MB body that is never sent. Afterwards, audit_event counted and readyz and GET /me checked.
checks_run.environment: as QA-R10-15/16; chromium-en and chromium-ar projects; both locale settings
checks_run.expected: exactly one 404 not_found problem+json with Connection: close for every request, never 400 or 5xx, the smuggled request never answered, no audit row, server stays ready
checks_run.actual: 1153 requests per project and locale setting (4 x 1153 in total): each answered by exactly one 404 not_found problem+json with Connection: close. The 500 MB declaration was answered in 0-3 ms. The audit_event count did not change, readyz returned 200 and the GET /me control returned 200.

checks_run.procedure: R10-02 (new, raw TCP). Upload evidence content as 'application/octet-stream; x=1', 'application/octet-stream\t; x=1' (Content-Length, and chunked with cuts at 1/5/4096/20000), 'application/octet-stream \t;\t x="quoted; value"' (chunked) and 'APPLICATION/Octet-Stream\t;x=1;\ty=2'. Bodies: all 256 byte values, invalid UTF-8 and random bytes. Then download, and compare against the evidence_content row in psql and the Digest header.
checks_run.expected: 200 for each; downloaded bytes equal the sent bytes; sha256 and size equal the DB row; Digest matches; an audit row per upload; Arabic/emoji file name round-trips
checks_run.actual: All 5 revisions answered 200 in both projects and both locale settings. The downloads are byte-identical, sha256 = DB = Digest, there is 1 audit row per upload, and the file name round-trips.

checks_run.procedure: R10-03 (new, raw TCP). POST evidence notes as 'application/json\t; charset=utf-8', 'application/json ;\tcharset="UTF-8"', 'Application/JSON\t;\tCharset=Utf-8' and 'application/json\t'. The text holds Arabic, RLM, emoji, ZWJ families, flags and combining marks, sent with chunked bodies cut at every UTF-8 continuation byte (57 chunks) or with Content-Length. Also PATCH the charter (If-Match) with the HTAB spelling. Read back through the API and psql.
checks_run.expected: 201/200; title, note and outOfScope verbatim through the API and in the DB
checks_run.actual: All 4 spellings returned 201 and the charter PATCH returned 200 (version 1->2). Title, note and outOfScope are stored verbatim (API and DB) in both projects and both locale settings. The UI round-trip (R8-04, 50 code points) also passed.

checks_run.procedure: R10-04 (new, raw TCP; two Content-Type field lines). POST transformations and PATCH charter with json+json, json+octet, octet+json, json;utf-8 twice, and json+text/plain. Upload with octet+octet, octet+text, text+octet, octet+json, and octet HTAB;x=1 + octet;x=1. Each with Content-Length and chunked. Then check psql (transformation rows, evidence_content rows, audit rows per request id), the charter version and the evidence store files.
checks_run.expected: 400 validation.content_type at pointer "" whose detail names the declared set (JSON ops: application/json; upload: application/octet-stream); nothing written; no audit row
checks_run.actual: 30 requests per project and locale setting all returned the declared 400 with the correct detail and no audit row. Nothing was written: transformations created 0, charter version unchanged, evidence version unchanged, currentContentId null, 0 content rows, 0 stored files.

checks_run.procedure: R10-05 (new, raw TCP). PATCH charter and POST transformations with JSON charset utf8, iso-8859-1 (byte E9 body), us-ascii, utf-16 and UTF-16LE (UTF-16 bodies), quoted windows-1256, utf-8 followed by latin1 (SP and HTAB variants), and quoted 'utf-8 '. Each with Content-Length and chunked.
checks_run.expected: 400 validation.content_type naming application/json; charter unchanged; no transformation created; no audit row
checks_run.actual: 36 requests per project and locale setting all returned the declared 400 naming application/json, with no audit row. The charter version is unchanged and transformations created = 0.

checks_run.procedure: R10-06 (new, raw TCP). The same 12 malformed or undeclared media types are sent to a JSON operation (POST evidence note) and to the octet-stream-only upload: a parameter without '=', an empty name, a list, an unterminated quoted-string, trailing text, whitespace in the type, */*, application/*, malformed octet-stream (x2), text/plain with HTAB, and form-urlencoded. Each with Content-Length and chunked.
checks_run.expected: JSON op detail always 'Send the request body as application/json.'; upload always 'Send the request body as application/octet-stream.' (never JSON); nothing written
checks_run.actual: 48 requests per project and locale setting matched the expected details exactly, with 0 notes created and 0 upload content rows. Static check: the shipped web client sends only application/json and application/octet-stream, so none of the D-070 tightenings affects it.

summary: PASS on candidate 7fd1a89c (source fe22d759). D-070/BE15 regression: an unmatched route returns 404 not_found with Connection: close for every body, media type, framing and session (4 x 1153 raw-socket requests); a smuggled request in the body is never answered; a declared 500 MB body is answered at once; no audit rows. Uploads with '; x=1' and with HTAB before ';' are stored byte-exact (sha256 = DB = Digest). 'application/json\t; charset=utf-8' is accepted, and Arabic/emoji text cut mid-character round-trips verbatim. Duplicate Content-Type lines and non-UTF-8 JSON charsets get the declared 400, which names the operation's declared set, and nothing is written. Full regression is green in both locale settings: static checks; unit 7/7 (765); integration 6/6 (610, QA suites included); product e2e 2/2 (64); qa-stack 2/2 (108); and axe 636 scans with 0 serious or critical. The R8-05/R9-05 form-level messages are still shown once in EN and AR. No new findings. Residuals D-057, D-058 and D-049 are PASS on the offline/config surface.
